items.title: Trane Or Allegion: Which One Is The Cheaper Way In?
items.summary: Trane Technologies (TT) and Allegion (ALLE) sell into the same buildings. A data center buys cooling from Trane and locks, readers and credentials from Allegion. Both raised their 2026 guidance at their latest reports, and that is where the agreement stops. Trane is spending to build capacity for an order book that runs into 2027, while Allegion raised on price and on demand it can already see.
